name: HIEF grants for community-led nature protection and restoration
summary: Grants of GBP 5,000 to 20,000 for community-led projects that protect and restore nature across the Scottish Highlands and Islands, mainly for local non-profits and community bodies. Pure research and individual PhD work are excluded.

calls.label: Late February - early March 2027 round

status.quote: The next grant deadline will be in late Feburary - early March 2027. Exact dates will be available on the HIEF website before the end of 2026.

calls.note: Next deadline expected late February to early March 2027; exact dates before end of 2026

applicant_types.quote: Local non-profit organisations, associations, clubs or unions, social co-operative enterprises and/or other local bodies, including research centres, are strongly encouraged to apply for grants.

geography.quote: The HIEF will support projects throughout the Scottish Highlands and Islands

access.quote: get in touch with [email protected] for a discussion prior to applying

window.quote: The next grant deadline will be in late Feburary - early March 2027.

amount.quote: HIEF awards grants between £5,000 and £20,000 for community-led projects that protect and restore nature in the Scottish Highlands & Islands.
